summary: Binding effect of SICA rehabilitation scheme; unsecured creditors cannot opt out of sanctioned scheme; Section 22 suspension vs Section 18(8) enforcement; legal proceedings suspended but debts remain subject to scheme terms; High Court error in allowing creditor to bypass scheme; rehabilitation scheme binding per Section 32 read with Section 18(8); scheme approval extinguishes claims beyond scaled payments; decree holders cannot claim super priority; larger public interest rationale upheld; dismissal of appeal against AAIFR order affirmed.
legal_provisions_cited: Sick Industrial Companies (Special Provisions) Act, 1985 s.18(8)
final_judgment: Civil Appeal No. 375 of 2017 allowed; High Court judgment set aside; order of AAIFR dated 23.06.2011 restored; unsecured creditor bound by rehabilitation scheme terms; decree holders cannot bypass sanctioned scheme.
